purpose: Complete closure checklist; pending rows are requirements, not claims of test execution.

completion_rules.private: All mandatory private rows pass on the final revision; real-only rows remain explicitly blocked until released.
completion_rules.real_integration: All mandatory released-original rows pass in addition to private rows; required snapshot scope is explicit.
completion_rules.operational: Every action selected by the human passes on the named target with its action-specific authorization.
completion_rules.not_applicable: Requires explicit documented applicability basis; never use it to hide unsupported required scope.
completion_rules.warnings: Distinct scenarios and repeated runs must be reported separately. Synthetic evidence does not satisfy real-world rows.
